zh: 塞内加尔达喀尔，45 岁
190 cm、修长、锐利颧骨、光头、细胡子；保留身高和修长感，但腿段自然，不能时装模特化。
en: Black man, about 45, tall and slim, about 190 cm; very dark skin, sharp cheekbones, shaved head, a thin mustache

identity: The same fictional Black man as the casting reference: about 45 years old, tall and slim, about 190 cm, realistic adult proportions about 7.5 heads tall (within 7.3–7.8), never a large head. Signature features: very dark skin, sharp cheekbones, shaved head, a thin mustache. Keep these features recognizable in every angle, expression and wardrobe.
stylization: Character stylization (A2, pushed): realistic adult body proportions at the actor-specific height and target range; normal head size, natural neck, torso, pelvis and leg lengths; never a large head, long neck, shortened torso or elongated fashion-model legs. Simplified 3D feature-animation facial planes, smooth stylized skin shading with no pores, and clean grouped hair clumps; never photoreal or a generic face.

looks.prompt: sage-green plain fitted crew-neck T-shirt, dark straight-leg trousers, clean white low-top sneakers, no jewelry, no watch, no accessories, no logos.

proposals.appearance: Provisional until Owner selects a proportion-corrected audition image
